verdict.rationale: Qodo lets you control where data lives through deployment choice: it documents multi-tenant, single-tenant, on-premises and air-gapped models, and can be deployed entirely within your own infrastructure. That gives residency control by self-hosting, but the evidence shows no region or residency selector for the hosted SaaS. Missing for 10: documented region selection for hosted/multi-tenant tenants, explicit data-residency guarantees or region list, independent corroboration.
